subject: Fix minor inconsistency in connFormatAddr size argument (#3098)
reason: The change replaces sizeof(addr) with sizeof(laddr) in a connFormatAddr call, but both buffers are declared with the same size (char [CONN_ADDR_STR_LEN]), so the passed value is the identical compile-time constant. It is a pure code-consistency refactor with no behaviour change: no reply, log output, buffer bound, or connection-handling path differs between the parent and the change, so no scenario can observe a difference and none is needed.
